questions.q: What did Lincoln's father do when he found his son reading?
a: He burned Lincoln's books
He sent him to school in town
He hired a tutor for him
He gave him a small library
questions.why: Lesson 1 says his illiterate father thought reading was a distraction and destroyed the books.

questions.q: Which rival defended escaped slaves and fought the Fugitive Slave Law?
a: Salmon Chase
William Seward
Edward Bates
Montgomery Blair
questions.why: Lesson 2 calls Chase the trailblazer of the anti-slavery cause for his legal work.

questions.q: How did Lincoln win the nomination despite a brief political career?
a: He stayed consistent on slavery and made friends rather than enemies
He outspent his rivals across the campaign
He won the backing of the sitting president
He promised cabinet posts to his rivals
questions.why: Lesson 2 says his rivals grew overconfident and made enemies while Lincoln built goodwill.

questions.q: How did Lincoln choose the members of his cabinet?
a: He picked the most qualified people regardless of party
He rewarded his closest friends and allies
He balanced the group by region alone
He chose only people who agreed with him
questions.why: Lesson 3 says he turned to his former rivals because ability mattered more than loyalty.

questions.q: How did many Southerners react to Lincoln's assassination?
a: They felt they had lost a valuable friend
They celebrated his death as a victory
They blamed the North for starting the war
They demanded a new election immediately
questions.why: Lesson 3 quotes Montgomery Blair saying Southern sympathizers knew they had lost a friend.
